description: Dr. Manjula announced that Karnataka’s existing data center policy is being revamped to meet current technological needs. A draft of the updated policy will be released soon for public feedback. The revised policy is expected to include incentives for water-efficient and energy-efficient operations in AI and data centres.
body_lead: The Karnataka government is working on mapping the state’s water and energy resources to support the development of AI data centers and strengthen future sustainability efforts. Dr. N. Manjula, Secretary of the Department of Electronics, IT, Biotechnology, Science and Technology, shared details of this ongoing work on Thursday (11 June 2026). “We are also identifying the potential areas, creating a heat map where the potential areas with water surplus and power surplus can be identified,” says Dr.
